title: Nourishing Slovakian Apples Skewers
description: A resinous, snappy post-workout Slovakian dish featuring grilled apples glazed with honey and cinnamon, diabetes-friendly and satisfying.

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.notes: medium, peeled and sliced into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Preheat a yakimono grill to medium-high heat, around 200°C.
Thread apple slices onto skewers, alternating with a pinch of salt.
Brush the apple pieces lightly with olive oil and sprinkle ground cinnamon evenly.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 3 minutes per side until the apples are tender and slightly caramelized.
While the apples are grilling, warm honey in a small saucepan until it becomes pourable.
Remove the skewers from the grill and drizzle warmed honey over the apples, then squeeze fresh lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped mint leaves before serving.
Serve immediately as a post-workout snack.
